import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Connect to the database
conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-083.sqlite')

# Function to get current year for reference
def get_current_year():
    return datetime.now().year

# Query 1: Monthly hire counts by organization
hire_query = """
SELECT 
    organization_name,
    strftime('%Y-%m', hire_date) AS month_year,
    COUNT(*) AS hire_count
FROM 
    workday__employee_overview
WHERE 
    hire_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    organization_name,
    month_year
ORDER BY
    organization_name,
    month_year
"""

# Query 2: Monthly departure counts by organization
departure_query = """
SELECT 
    organization_name,
    strftime('%Y-%m', departure_date) AS month_year,
    COUNT(*) AS departure_count
FROM 
    workday__employee_overview
WHERE 
    departure_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    organization_name,
    month_year
ORDER BY
    organization_name,
    month_year
"""

# Query 3: Average tenure by organization
tenure_query = """
SELECT 
    organization_name,
    AVG(tenure_years) AS avg_tenure_years
FROM 
    workday__employee_overview
GROUP BY
    organization_name
ORDER BY
    avg_tenure_years DESC
"""

# Execute queries and load into DataFrames
hire_df = pd.read_sql(hire_query, conn)
departure_df = pd.read_sql(departure_query, conn)
tenure_df = pd.read_sql(tenure_query, conn)

# Close connection
conn.close()

# Display results
print("Monthly Hire Counts by Organization:")
print(hire_df.head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMonthly Departure Counts by Organization:")
print(departure_df.head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nAverage Tenure by Organization:")
print(tenure_df.to_string(index=False))

# Save results to CSV files for further analysis
hire_df.to_csv('monthly_hires_by_org.csv', index=False)
departure_df.to_csv('monthly_departures_by_org.csv', index=False)
tenure_df.to_csv('avg_tenure_by_org.csv', index=False)

print("\nResults saved to CSV files for further analysis.")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the saved data
hire_df = pd.read_csv('monthly_hires_by_org.csv')
departure_df = pd.read_csv('monthly_departures_by_org.csv')
tenure_df = pd.read_csv('avg_tenure_by_org.csv')

# 1. Time Series Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=hire_df, x='month_year', y='hire_count', 
             hue='organization_name', legend='full')
plt.title('Monthly Hiring Trends by Organization')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('hiring_trends.png')
plt.close()

# 2. Departure Analysis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=departure_df, x='month_year', y='departure_count', 
             hue='organization_name', legend='full')
plt.title('Monthly Departure Trends by Organization')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('departure_trends.png')
plt.close()

# 3. Tenure Distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=tenure_df, x='organization_name', y='avg_tenure_years')
plt.title('Average Tenure by Organization')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('tenure_distribution.png')
plt.close()

# 4. Calculate Turnover Metrics
# Merge hire/departure data
merged = pd.merge(
    hire_df.groupby('month_year')['hire_count'].sum().reset_index(),
    departure_df.groupby('month_year')['departure_count'].sum().reset_index(),
    on='month_year'
)
merged['turnover_rate'] = (merged['departure_count'] / merged['hire_count']) * 100

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=merged, x='month_year', y='turnover_rate')
plt.title('Monthly Turnover Rate (%)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('turnover_rate.png')
plt.close()

# Save enhanced metrics
merged.to_csv('turnover_metrics.csv', index=False)

print("Visualizations and enhanced metrics saved successfully.")
